headline: $3B Blackwell server leak exposes US chip-control gap
body: A quiet day with one story. The New York Times reported a US subsidiary of blacklisted Inspur shipped about $3 billion of Nvidia Blackwell servers to Southeast Asia. Leaky export controls weaken Global Coordination, nudging Self-Destruction up and Gatekeeper down. Horizon Balance is -5.36.
movers_note: Gatekeeper -0.1 and Self-Destruction +0.1, both from the Blackwell export-control story (-0.14, +0.10).
